Tannery's Pear

Tannery's Pear is a surface of revolution, given by a parametrisation, genus 0, immersed with singularities.

Definition

half a Gerono lemniscate (rho = sin u cos u) stretched vertically by 2 sqrt2 and revolved, at the operator's default scale a = 1 -- the default TANNERY_PEAR variant (the hourglass revolves the whole lemniscate, u in [-pi/2, pi/2]). The builder fits its output to the 2 m cube; verification applies the same centre-and-scale to the chart

Sources

Chart reproduced numerically against the shipped implementation: fwd max 0.67 of tol, 0.0% of oracle beyond tol (tol floor 2.5 x 0.01537).

  • J. Tannery (1892); the surface of revolution of half a Gerono lemniscate.
